headline: Networks halt TV pool coverage of Trump after CNN White House ban – live

members.title: Networks halt TV pool coverage of Trump after CNN White House ban – live
members.lead: NBC, ABC, CBS and Fox News, the fourth other networks that make up the White House TV pool, decided they would cease coverage in solidarity with banned CNN Sign up for US Breaking News emails The three outlets President Trump banned from the White House last Friday have filed their lawsuit against his administration to restore their access. “This ban could not be a more direct assault on the First Amendment nor a more blatant violation of our most fundamental constitutional principles,” CNN, MS Now and Politico wrote in a complaint filed in the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia. Continue reading...

members.title: US TV networks suspend White House pool coverage over Trump media ban
members.lead: ABC, CBS, Fox News and NBC decline to participate after presidential ban that prompted wide condemnation Major US TV news networks agreed to refuse to air coverage of Donald Trump’s White House after the administration banned certain media outlets including CNN from the grounds. The ban left CNN unable to fulfill its duties as Monday’s White House designated pool broadcaster. Continue reading...
